"""All frozen solar inputs through original JPL/CALCEPH/SOFA, no Fate import."""
import ctypes as C
from datetime import date
import gzip
import hashlib
from importlib.metadata import version
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq, minimize_scalar

assert not any(name.startswith('fatebridge') for name in sys.modules)
base=Path(__file__).parent
plan=json.loads((base/'solar-all-inputs-jpl-plan.json').read_text())
output=base/'solar-all-inputs-jpl-reference.jsonl'
assert not output.exists(), 'Inspect the existing job/receipt; do not restart over partial evidence.'
lib_path=base/'calceph-build/src/libcalceph.2.1.1.dylib'
cal=C.CDLL(str(lib_path));sofa=C.CDLL(str(base/'libofficial_sofa.dylib'))
author=C.CDLL(str(base/'libauthor_swiss_2_10_03_contract.dylib'))
geometry=C.CDLL(str(base/'libsolar_reference_geometry_all_epochs.dylib'))
DP=C.POINTER(C.c_double)
cal.calceph_open.argtypes=[C.c_char_p];cal.calceph_open.restype=C.c_void_p
cal.calceph_close.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];cal.calceph_close.restype=None
cal.calceph_compute_unit.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_double,C.c_double,C.c_int,C.c_int,C.c_int,DP]
cal.calceph_compute_unit.restype=C.c_int
cal.calceph_getversion_str.argtypes=[C.c_char_p];cal.calceph_getversion_str.restype=None
cal.calceph_getfileversion.argtypes=[C.c_void_p,C.c_char_p];cal.calceph_getfileversion.restype=C.c_int
cal.calceph_gettimescale.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];cal.calceph_gettimescale.restype=C.c_int
v=C.create_string_buffer(1024);cal.calceph_getversion_str(v);assert v.value==b'5.0.1'
kernel_paths={
    'DE440':base/'original-de440.bsp',
    'DE441':Path(json.loads((base/'original-de441-cache-receipt.json').read_text())['path']),
}
descriptors={};kernel_versions={}
for name,path in kernel_paths.items():
    descriptor=cal.calceph_open(str(path).encode());assert descriptor
    fv=C.create_string_buffer(1024);version_status=cal.calceph_getfileversion(descriptor,fv)
    if name=='DE441':assert version_status==1 and fv.value==b'DE441',(name,version_status,fv.value)
    # SPK need not carry this optional INPOP/JPL-header version field. Its
    # original download receipt and full-file hash identify the DE440 input.
    else:assert version_status in (0,1)
    assert cal.calceph_gettimescale(descriptor)==1
    descriptors[name]=descriptor;kernel_versions[name]=dict(status=version_status,value=fv.value.decode() if version_status else None)
sofa.iauDtdb.argtypes=[C.c_double]*6;sofa.iauDtdb.restype=C.c_double
sofa.iauAb.argtypes=[DP,DP,C.c_double,C.c_double,DP];sofa.iauAb.restype=None
sofa.iauDat.argtypes=[C.c_int,C.c_int,C.c_int,C.c_double,DP];sofa.iauDat.restype=C.c_int
author.swe_set_ephe_path.argtypes=[C.c_char_p]
author.swe_deltat_ex.argtypes=[C.c_double,C.c_int,C.c_char_p];author.swe_deltat_ex.restype=C.c_double
author.swe_refrac_extended.argtypes=[C.c_double]*5+[C.c_int,DP];author.swe_refrac_extended.restype=C.c_double
geometry.fb_reference_receiver.argtypes=[C.c_double]*5+[DP];geometry.fb_reference_receiver.restype=C.c_int
geometry.fb_reduce_reference_direction.argtypes=[C.c_double]*3+[C.c_int,DP,DP,DP]
geometry.fb_reduce_reference_direction.restype=C.c_int
threshold=author.swe_refrac_extended(0.,0.,1013.25,0.,.0065,1,(C.c_double*4)())
c04_path=base/'root-clock-inputs/iers-c04-ut1-v1.json.gz'
c04=json.loads(gzip.decompress(c04_path.read_bytes()));c04_u=[];c04_t=[];dat_warnings=[]
for mjd,dut1,sigma in c04['records']:
    day=date.fromordinal(mjd+678576);offset=C.c_double()
    status=sofa.iauDat(day.year,day.month,day.day,0.,C.byref(offset));assert status in (0,1)
    if status:dat_warnings.append(mjd)
    civil=mjd+2400000.5;c04_u.append(civil+float(dut1)/86400);c04_t.append(civil+(offset.value+32.184)/86400)


class ClockUnavailable(Exception):
    pass


def clock(ut1,policy):
    if policy=='c04':
        if not c04_u[0]<=ut1<=c04_u[-1]:raise ClockUnavailable(ut1)
        return float(np.interp(ut1,c04_u,c04_t))
    flag=-1 if ut1<2436934.5 else 2
    delta=author.swe_deltat_ex(ut1,flag,C.create_string_buffer(256))
    assert math.isfinite(delta)
    return ut1+delta


def original_state(descriptor,body,whole,fraction):
    values=np.full(6,np.nan)
    # CALCEPH_UNIT_KM(2) | CALCEPH_UNIT_DAY(4): SPK has no AU constant;
    # use explicit physical units, then the exact IAU 2012 AU in km.
    status=cal.calceph_compute_unit(descriptor,2451545.+whole,float(fraction),body,12,6,values.ctypes.data_as(DP))
    if not status or not np.isfinite(values).all():raise RuntimeError(('original source unavailable',body,whole,fraction))
    values/=149597870.7
    return values[:3],values[3:]


start_tt=date(1700,1,1).toordinal()+1721424.5
end_tt=date(2301,1,1).toordinal()+1721424.5
families={family:json.loads((base/f'solar-event-{family}-cases.json').read_text()) for family in plan['families']}
expected_counts=plan['input_counts'];assert all(len(families[k])==n for k,n in expected_counts.items())
results=[];cache={};started=time.perf_counter();unique_calls=0
stream=output.open('x')
for family,cases in families.items():
    for index,case in enumerate(cases):
        query=case['query_ut1'];end=query+26/24
        key=(query,case['longitude'],case['latitude'],case['definition'],case['clock'],case['no_data'])
        cached=key in cache
        if not cached:
            unique_calls+=1
            author.swe_set_ephe_path((str(base/'empty-solar-event-ephemeris') if case['no_data'] else '/Users/thomas/Desktop/FateBridge/ephe').encode())
            try:
                first_tt,last_tt=clock(query,case['clock']),clock(end,case['clock'])
            except ClockUnavailable:
                cache[key]=dict(status='clock_unavailable',roots=[],evaluations=0)
            else:
                name='DE440' if start_tt<=first_tt<=last_tt<end_tt else 'DE441'
                descriptor=descriptors[name];horizon=threshold if case['definition'] else 0.;samples={}

                def at(delta):
                    ut1=float(query+float(delta))
                    if ut1 not in samples:
                        tt=clock(ut1,case['clock']);relative=tt-2451545.;whole=math.floor(relative)
                        fraction=relative-whole+sofa.iauDtdb(2451545.,relative,0.,0.,0.,0.)/86400
                        pv=np.full(34,np.nan)
                        status=geometry.fb_reference_receiver(tt,ut1,case['longitude'],case['latitude'],0.,pv.ctypes.data_as(DP));assert status==0,(status,tt)
                        earth,velocity=original_state(descriptor,3,whole,fraction)
                        receiver=earth+(pv[:3] if case['definition'] else 0.)
                        speed=velocity+(pv[3:6] if case['definition'] else 0.)
                        current_sun,_=original_state(descriptor,11,whole,fraction)
                        solar_distance=float(np.linalg.norm(current_sun-receiver));delay=0.
                        for iterations in range(12):
                            emitted,_=original_state(descriptor,11,whole,fraction-delay)
                            ray=emitted-receiver;distance=float(np.linalg.norm(ray));new_delay=distance/173.14463267424034
                            if new_delay==delay or abs(new_delay-delay)<1e-16:break
                            delay=new_delay
                        else:raise RuntimeError('Original JPL light cone did not converge')
                        unit=ray/distance;beta=speed/173.14463267424034;apparent=np.full(3,np.nan)
                        sofa.iauAb(unit.ctypes.data_as(DP),beta.ctypes.data_as(DP),solar_distance,math.sqrt(1-float(beta@beta)),apparent.ctypes.data_as(DP))
                        result=np.full(4,np.nan)
                        status=geometry.fb_reduce_reference_direction(tt,case['longitude'],case['latitude'],case['definition'],pv.ctypes.data_as(DP),apparent.ctypes.data_as(DP),result.ctypes.data_as(DP));assert status==0,status
                        samples[ut1]=(float(result[3]-horizon),tt)
                    return samples[ut1][0]

                grid=[i/1440 for i in range(1561)];values=[at(point) for point in grid]
                brackets=[];extrema=[]
                for j in range(1,len(grid)-1):
                    a,b,c=values[j-1:j+2]
                    if b>a and b>=c:sign=-1
                    elif b<a and b<=c:sign=1
                    else:continue
                    brackets.append((grid[j-1],grid[j+1],sign))
                brackets.extend((a,b,sign) for a,b in [(0.,2/1440),(26/24-2/1440,26/24)] for sign in (-1,1))
                for lower,upper,sign in brackets:
                    centre=(lower+upper)/2
                    solved=minimize_scalar(lambda q:sign*at(centre+q),bounds=(lower-centre,upper-centre),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-12,'maxiter':150})
                    assert solved.success

                    extrema.append(dict(ut1=float(query+point),kind='maximum' if sign<0 else 'minimum',residual_degrees=at(point)))

                    if not(rising or setting):continue
                    root,info=brentq(at,lower,upper,xtol=5e-15,rtol=4*np.finfo(float).eps,maxiter=150,full_output=True);assert info.converged
                    ut1=float(query+root)

                    events.append(dict(ut1=ut1,tt=samples[ut1][1],kind='rise' if rising else 'set',residual_degrees=at(root)))
                cache[key]=dict(status='ok',source=name,roots=events,extrema=extrema,evaluations=len(samples))
        row=dict(family=family,case=index,input=case,reference=cache[key],reused_identical_physics=cached)
        results.append(row);stream.write(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':'))+'\n');stream.flush()

            progress=dict(rows=len(results),unique_physics=unique_calls,source_clock_failures=sum(r['reference']['status']!='ok' for r in results),seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)
            (base/'solar-all-inputs-jpl-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(progress,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(progress),flush=True)
stream.close()
assert len(results)==10288
report=dict(plan=plan,production_imported=False,rows=results,
            clock=dict(c04_sha256=hashlib.sha256(c04_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),sofa_dat_warning_mjds=dat_warnings),
            provenance=dict(calceph_version=v.value.decode(),kernel_versions=kernel_versions,
                kernel_receipts={name:json.loads((base/file).read_text()) for name,file in [('DE440','de440-download.json'),('DE441','original-de441-cache-receipt.json')]},
                source_lineage=json.loads((base/'de441-source-lineage-check.json').read_text()),

            scope=plan['scope'])
target=base/'solar-all-inputs-jpl-reference.json.gz';target.write_bytes(gzip.compress(json.dumps(report,separators=(',',':')).encode(),mtime=0))
summary=dict(rows=len(results),unique_physics=unique_calls,source_clock_failures=sum(r['reference']['status']!='ok' for r in results),events=sum(len(r['reference']['roots']) for r in results),reference_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)
(base/'solar-all-inputs-jpl-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
for descriptor in descriptors.values():cal.calceph_close(descriptor)
